file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to edit.

specs.description:
Cell edits: each spec addresses a table by ordinal (to-json export
order) plus one of `at` {row,col} (covered positions resolve to their
merge anchor), `right_of` LABEL, or `below` LABEL (normalized exact
match). `text` "" clears the cell. All-or-nothing.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

table.description: Table ordinal in the shared traversal order (see `to-json` export).

text.description: Replacement text; the empty string clears the cell.

oneOf.description: A logical grid coordinate (covered positions resolve to their anchor).
The cell immediately right of the uniquely labeled cell.
The cell immediately below the uniquely labeled cell.

GridCoord.description: Absolute position on the pre-merge logical grid, zero-based.
